prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a bright snowfield with bare trees under a pale sky, a wooden fence of normal height and a cabin with a standard-size door in the distance, bright and evenly lit with crisp defined shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as the figure, NO dark background NO black void, ONE person standing, the camera set back far enough that the whole figure is visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, under hard direct flash lighting, sharp focus on the figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

ONE real adult Hawaiian person with the face of a beautiful woman, the face exactly the same tone as the body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, sleek silver-grey hair styled in a layered tousled shag cut, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a single long platinum chain ending in one large faceted amethyst drop, and on the other ear a large platinum hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on platinum chains of different lengths (a bronze ship's anchor, a gold round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single mixed-metal necklace. Extremely long coffin nails, glitter finish studded with crystals.
Physique: the body of an extraordinarily large and powerful man, far beyond any real person. A massive V-shaped torso: enormously broad shoulders with capped, rounded deltoids, a thick heavy chest, a deeply carved six-pack abdomen narrowing to a comparatively small waist, huge thick arms with split biceps and horseshoe triceps, wide flaring lats, and powerful thick quads and diamond calves. The head stays in correct proportion to the broad frame; the arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
Body Art: The bare skin is painted in Thai Benjarong porcelain (a black ground with five-colour jewel enamels in lotus-petal motifs), wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense tiered lotus-petal work filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers the whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of the hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of the feet. The face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
Pose: leaning one arm on a window frame.
Footwear: Extreme cobalt-blue thigh-high stiletto boots with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each painted pattern reflecting the flash in sharp specular glints, the hard light carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, the face toward the camera.
